1.

Father, Thou hast in Thy love Called us sons. Thou hast loved us ere the world Was founded.

2.

The Son hath come, He who is called “Wonderful” and “Counsellor;” Of His fulness Thou hast given us “Grace upon grace.”

3.

Freely Thy great grace now reigneth In righteousness, And we possess a perfect Salvation.

4.

May we then by the Spirit be led Here unto Thy pleasure! Short is the time, soon breaketh in “The day of Christ.”

5.

The sons then at home shall be, At home each one, Thee to everlasting praise, O Father, In Thy home.
